title: Cookies Into Toffifees!
description: Turns Cookies into Toffifees! from the Toffifee! mod
body:
Want toffifees in your world? but you are playing Vanilla minecraft? or on Servers?

No problem! this resource pack turns Cookies into Toffifees From the Toffifee! Mod! now you can enjoy delicious Toffifees in Vanilla minecraft!

Works with every version at 1.16.5 and newer if not tell me in the comments!

Thats all! have fun eating delicious Toffifees in Vanilla Minecraft! :)
